leftEvidence.title: The LORD promises a new covenant marked by internal law, belonging, knowledge, and forgiveness

points.label: Newness
points.left: The promised covenant is unlike the broken exodus covenant.
points.right: The cup is called the new covenant in Jesus’ blood.

points.label: Stated effects
points.left: Jeremiah names law within, knowing God, and forgiveness.
points.right: Luke names remembrance, blood poured for the disciples, and kingdom fulfillment.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving witness, setting, sequence, speaker, genre, and stated inference boundary.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus names the cup after supper as the new covenant in his blood

payload.tension: Luke’s short cup saying invokes new-covenant language without restating Jeremiah’s full promise.
payload.title: The promised new covenant and Luke’s cup
